verses.en: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.sm: Aikupito, o le aiga o lakopo nai le nuu gagana ese; ona fai lea o luta mona nuu paia,

verses.en: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
verses.sm: o Isaraelu o le na ia pule i ai. Ua iloa atu e le sami,

verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.sm: ona sola ai lea; ua liliu i tua Ioritana. Ua feosofai mau

verses.en: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.sm: ga faapei o mamoe poa, ma mauga iti pei o tamai mamoe.

verses.en: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
verses.sm: Le sami e, se a ea le mea na e sola ai? O oe loritana e, se a le mea na e liliu ai i tua?

verses.en: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.sm: O outou mauga na outou feosofai faapei o mamoe poa i se a? ma outou mauga iti pei o tamai mamoe i se a?

verses.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
verses.sm: Leeleele e, ina gatete ia oe i luma o le AW, i luma o le Atua o lakopo;

verses.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.sm: ole na te liua le papa e fai ma vailepa; II 12 13 o le papa ala e fai ma vaipuna.
